{"basis":"Splitting at the semicolon separates the header-placement condition from the handling of directives outside that block while preserving Atlas CE behavior and Ptah's WARN reporting.","decision":"admit","item_id":"941d33611892dd0d","replacement":"The header is significant only in
the unbroken run of line comments that begins on line 1. A directive outside
that block is ignored, as it is on Atlas CE, and reported at `WARN` rather than
dropped in silence.","source_sha256":"064cbfe0da8f3bdb90903c3643a33f46504d099f977819f99d3ac489d9eea443","target_end_byte":9216,"target_start_byte":9006}
